[Assistant]: 

The memory server can't re-tag documents — `PATCH /v3/documents/:id` ignores `containerTags` and `POST /v3/container-tags/merge` fails with HTTP 500 in `WORKFLOW_ENGINE=direct` mode, so stored documents never move between container tags. Clones of one remote share memory instead through a registry in `data/projects.json` that links them by normalized origin URL: all clones write to one shared tag and read that tag plus each clone's pre-existing tags (`Project.containerTag` / `Project.readTags`), so nothing is moved or re-extracted.
